report.summary: Chunk 1 of embeddings.py: module docstring describing identity anchoring, drift detection, and limits; constants and utility functions.
risks: IDENTITY_DRIFT_TOLERANCE | medium | Tolerance set to 1e-4; may be too tight or too loose depending on backend nondeterminism. | Verify against actual Ollama and other provider reproducibility.
MOVABLE_TAG_PROVIDERS | medium | Only 'ollama' is listed; other providers with movable tags (e.g., OpenAI deployment aliases) are not covered. | Confirm whether other providers need to be added.
_utc_now | low | Uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() which includes microsecond precision; may cause unexpected key granularity. | Check if microsecond precision is intended.
_canonical_json | medium | Uses sort_keys=True but no separators specified; default separators add trailing spaces. | Verify if JSON output is intended to be compact (no extra spaces).
todos: Review IDENTITY_DRIFT_TOLERANCE value against empirical data.
Confirm list of MOVABLE_TAG_PROVIDERS is complete.
Check that _canonical_json output is canonical enough for hashing (no trailing spaces).
